title: Small steps: Pause before the label
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
pressureLine: Why do you always make this so hard?
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: The transition still needs to happen.
practice: name one thing you can see and one next step
principle: Notice when pressure is turning an event into an identity label.
nextSentence: The transition still needs to happen. First, name one thing you can see and one next step.
keyLearning: Notice when pressure is turning an event into an identity label.
